name: Avani Lesotho Hotel & Casino
description: Large four-star hotel in the centre of Maseru with a pool, a children's pool, a spa and a casino. A comfortable base for the capital.

name: Mpilo Boutique Hotel
description: Small boutique hotel in Maseru with free parking and breakfast. Children are welcome, but there is no pool or play area.

name: Semonkong Lodge
description: Community-minded lodge beside the Maletsunyane River. Guests ride ponies, hike and abseil, and families with children are catered for.

name: Thaba-Bosiu
description: The flat-topped mountain where King Moshoeshoe I built his stronghold and founded the Basotho nation. Visitors can climb it and learn the story.

name: Maletsunyane Falls
description: A tall waterfall on the Maletsunyane River near Semonkong. It is a viewing and abseiling destination reached by a rough track.

name: Malealea Lodge
description: Village lodge in the Makhomalong Valley with rondavels, rooms and campsites. Known for pony treks, hikes, a swimming pool and evening choir performances.

name: Botsoela Waterfall
description: A waterfall about 40 m high near Malealea, reached by a four-hour hike or pony ride, or by a rough 4x4 track down the valley.

name: Malealea Bushman Paintings (Pitseng Gorge)
description: Ancient San rock paintings in hanging caves inside Pitseng Gorge, visited on a guided hike or pony trek from Malealea Lodge.

name: Hotel Mount Maluti
description: The oldest hotel in southern Lesotho, in Mohale's Hoek town, with a pool and restaurant. The hotel can arrange maps and guides for local trips.

name: Old Hoek Guest House
description: Three-star guest house in Old Mohale's Hoek with a bar, restaurant and breakfast. Close to museums and mission sites in the south.

name: Ketane Waterfall
description: A 122 m waterfall in remote country, reached on a multi-day pony trek that passes through traditional villages.

name: Masitise Cave House Museum
description: A missionary house built into a rock shelter, now a small museum run with the Morija Museum. The key is kept by a caretaker nearby.

name: Quthing Dinosaur Footprints
description: Fossil dinosaur tracks in the rock near Quthing, among the most important sets in the region.

name: Qomoqomong Rock Paintings
description: A large panel of San rock paintings in the mountain village of Qomoqomong, south-east of Quthing town.

name: Sehlabathebe National Park
description: A remote high-altitude park of sandstone formations, rock pools and rock art, part of the Maloti-Drakensberg World Heritage Site.

name: Letloepe Lodge
description: Family-owned lodge about 1 km from the centre of Qacha's Nek, with a bar, garden, rooms and traditional-style huts. Gateway to Sehlabathebe.

name: Tsoelike River Lodge
description: Riverside accommodation near Sehlabathebe, listed about 44 km from Qacha's Nek. Fishing and horse riding are nearby.

name: Katse Dam
description: One of Africa's highest dams, with a visitor centre that runs dam wall tours, plus boat trips on the reservoir.

name: Katse Botanical Garden
description: A hillside garden by the Katse reservoir with walking trails, a rock garden and a viewpoint over the dam.

name: Mohale Oa Masite Hotel
description: Two-star hotel on Main Street in Thaba-Tseka town, with free parking. A practical stop for travellers in the highlands.

name: Motherland Guest House
description: Guest house in Thaba-Tseka town with free breakfast, parking and a terrace. Katse Dam is a drive of about two hours.

name: Sani Pass
description: A steep, winding mountain pass on the South African border with spectacular views. Most visitors take a guided 4x4 tour.

name: Sani Mountain Lodge
description: Mountain lodge at the top of Sani Pass, known for the highest pub in Africa. Accommodation runs from camping to self-catering cottages.

name: Boikhethelo Guest House
description: Three-star guest house in Mokhotlong town with free breakfast, parking and WiFi. A simple stop for travellers heading to Sani Pass.

name: Maliba Lodge
description: Mountain lodge inside Ts'ehlanyane National Park, with a children's club, hiking, horse riding and archery.

name: Ts'ehlanyane National Park
description: A protected mountain park with indigenous forest and rivers, popular for hiking. Guides can be arranged at the gate.

name: Liphofung Cave Cultural Historical Site
description: A large rock overhang once used by San people and by King Moshoeshoe I. It has a small visitor centre, guided cave walks and a craft shop.

name: Liphofung Cave Chalets
description: Riverside chalets a short walk from Liphofung Cave, with hiking, cycling and horse riding on site.

name: Subeng River Dinosaur Footprints
description: Dinosaur tracks preserved in sandstone in a small stream about 7 km north of Hlotse. A local guide helps find them.

name: Leribe Craft Centre
description: A well-known centre in Hlotse where local women make hand-spun mohair scarves, blankets and ponchos.

name: Mountain View Hotel
description: Three-star hotel in Hlotse with a restaurant, bar and family rooms. A good base for the northern district.

name: Bokong Nature Reserve
description: One of the highest nature reserves in Africa, on the Mafika Lisiu Pass, with a visitor centre above the Lepaqoa Valley, short walks and pony rides.

name: Ha Kome Cave Houses
description: Cave dwellings built into a sandstone overhang that are still lived in, about 21 km from Teyateyaneng. A local guide is included in the entrance fee.

name: Blue Mountain Inn
description: Three-star inn in Teyateyaneng with a pool, bar-restaurant and breakfast. Close to Ha Kome and the town's weaving centres.

name: Elelloang Basali Weavers
description: A women's weaving group in Teyateyaneng that makes hand-spun mohair rugs and tapestries in a building made of recycled cans.
